data.name: Jeevanksh
data.gender_notes: Jeevanksh is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jeevanksh is a unisex name derived from the Sanskrit words 'jeevan' (life) and 'ksh' (force). It represents the vital life force present in all living beings. The name Jeevanksh carries the meaning “Life Force” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jeevanksh usually hope their child will grow to embody life force and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Jeevanksh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Life Force.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jeevanksh total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jeevanksh carries the essence of life and energy in Hindu culture. It is a reminder of the significance of preserving life and respecting the life force in all living beings. This name is not only appreciated in India but also by the Indian diaspora and non-Indians who resonate with its meaning.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu spirituality, the name Jeevanksh holds deep significance. It symbolizes the inner energy or 'prana shakti' that helps sustain the physical body. The name is believed to bestow blessings of good health, strength, and vitality upon the bearer. Additionally, it reminds us of the connection between the physical and spiritual realms and reinforces our duty to honor the divine spark within ourselves and others.
